mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, role, status, create_time, update_time FROM user ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET role = #{role}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
